# JavaScript

- Qooxdoo frontend (`services/static-webserver/client/source/class/`): follow the
  surrounding class structure and naming, and lint with ESLint
  (`eslint-config-qx`) via `npm run linter` / `npm run linter-fix`.
- Playwright e2e tests (`tests/e2e-frontend/`): follow the existing test and
  fixture layout.
